title: Principles
slide_intent: Show how tracking, kerning and leading change the way a short headline and a paragraph can be read. Setting the roles together makes their different densities visible.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can retain its emphatic headline while giving readers enough space to follow supporting copy.
demonstration: The page pairs a compact uppercase headline with a lower Raleway subhead and body specimen. Pink notes label optical kerning and negative tracking values for both roles.
practical_value: Use the page’s headline and body settings as starting references and judge leading with the text at its final size.

content_islands.name: Typesetting guidance
content_islands.spec: Separate the guidance for headlines from the guidance for body copy and subheads in the left text column.

content_islands.name: Headline settings
content_islands.spec: Align the large multiline headline above the body sample. Label the Quasimoda Heavy tracking and optical kerning beside it.

content_islands.name: Reading sample
content_islands.spec: Set a bold Raleway subhead above a regular paragraph. Annotate each with its settings and use the lower sample to show interline space.
